title: mozak v0.3.0 — Agent Chat + Obsidian IDE (Pomodoro Study Timer)

scopes.title: Pomodoro Study Timer
plans: Play a bell sound when the timer ends (session-alert)

beats.headerTitle: 01 You ask in plain words → Agent reads the project & asks 1 question
beats.userPrompt: /mozak study-timer — add a bell sound when the 25-minute timer ends, plus a mute button
agentReplyLines: Pomodoro Study Timer (study-timer) has 1 completed plan (25-minute focus countdown).
Before I draft session-alert, one question:
Q1: Can both steps (bell-sound at 00:00 and mute-button) be checked
by automated audio tests, or do you want to sign off yourself?
beats.caption: You type /mozak and ask in plain words. The agent reads the project notes first, then asks one question.

beats.headerTitle: 02 It drafts, then waits for you → Obsidian shows 'awaiting approval'
agentReplyLines: Drafted session-alert (Play a bell sound when the timer ends) with 2 outcomes:
1. bell-sound  — Plays a clear bell sound when the countdown reaches 00:00
2. mute-button — Stays completely silent when Mute is turned on
Check study-timer/mozak.md in Obsidian and reply to approve direction.
beats.caption: The agent writes the plan into mozak.json and mozak.md. Obsidian shows 'awaiting approval': nothing happens until you say yes.

beats.headerTitle: 03 You approve the direction → Plan turns Open & 'Bell sound' lights up
beats.userPrompt: Looks good — approve direction for session-alert.
agentReplyLines: Direction approved! study-timer/mozak.json and study-timer/mozak.md updated.
• Current roadmap stop: #1 bell-sound (Plays a bell sound at 00:00)
• Obsidian roadmap & sidebar progress strip updated live.
beats.caption: Your yes unlocks the plan. In Obsidian it turns Open, and the roadmap's first step, Bell sound, becomes the current stop.

beats.headerTitle: 04 It runs the test & records proof → 'Bell sound' turns green (1/2 done)
beats.userPrompt: Run the bell audio test and record the observation.

toolCalls.label: ⚙ bash: node test/bell-sound.test.js  →  PASS (bell sound played at 00:00)

agentReplyLines: Recorded passing evidence (ev-bell-test: Bell sound played at 00:00).
✓ Outcome 1/2 (bell-sound): done — green in sidebar & Mermaid roadmap
→ Next roadmap stop: #2 mute-button (Silent when Mute is on)
Saved in git & Obsidian so any future agent session picks up here.
beats.caption: The test result is saved as evidence in the plan. Obsidian marks Bell sound done, and the roadmap moves on to Mute button.
